id.description: stable: notes have their own, learned items are named after what they're about

source.description: you wrote it, or Alden learned it from your feedback

kind.description: a note, a check's flags, or how PRs rank in the queue

group.description: what you look for (ranked higher, shown) or what you skip

examples.description: for learned items: how many reactions it was learned from

text.description: what Alden knows, in one sentence

evidence.description: for learned items: what it was learned from, e.g. 'agreed 5 of 5 times'

effect.description: what it changes, e.g. 'ranks these PRs higher'
